messages:
Dina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing segment. Two quick clarifications: 1) exact reset time for dev credits? 2) will there be a self-serve path for short-term test exemptions for CI?

Leah (CEO): Reset is 00:00 UTC on the 1st. Exemptions are manual today; we're shipping a self-serve flow H2 for org admins.

Sana (Finance): Dev credits are fixed monthly and don't roll over by default. Enterprise SOWs can request rollover or buffers. For big exemptions (>1M tokens/month) finance approval still required.

Kai (Product): For CI we're prototyping short-lived tokens and a header-based flag so infra can run ephemeral load tests without long approvals. Still needs audit + guardrails.

Dina: Nice. Any idea on thresholds for auto-approve vs manual?

Sana (Finance): Early plan: under 100k tokens/day auto-approved; above that goes through a lightweight manager approval. Final thresholds TBD.

Kai (Product): UX note: Console will have an "Exemptions" panel with history and remaining allowance in the pilot.

OpsBot: Doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing-exemptions (draft)

Dina: Thanks! I'll file a GH issue to track header token + metrics accounting. :thumbsup:

Leah (CEO): Thanks everyone — will update product board and loop in pilot customers.
